source='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

print(mod.transform(grid))
